answer: Bind each agent seat to a credential from an accredited gem-grading lab. An appraiser earns it only after supervised months at the bench, telling real opal from glass and natural marble from resin, then passes a proctored practical exam tied to a government ID. The lab publishes a register and revokes the credential after one faked report. Tuition, exam and bonding run about $25,000 per appraiser, so 400 sybil seats would cost $10M, a cost horizon no reward pool reaches.
